name: Peel Centralized Shelter Intake and Homeless Supports
description: Centralized intake for emergency and transitional shelter, street outreach, support services, and help finding permanent housing in Peel Region.
address: 10 Peel Centre Dr, Suite A and B, Brampton, ON L6T 4B9
eligibility_notes: Serving individuals 16 years and older and families who are homeless or at risk of becoming homeless; Peel residency requirements require human L1 confirmation before live entry.
application_process: Call the Centralized Shelter Intake line for shelter access and screening.

hours.notes: Centralized Shelter Intake is listed as Monday to Sunday, 24 hours.

hours_text: Centralized Shelter Intake Monday to Sunday, 24 hours; Street Outreach hours require review if represented separately.
